title: Reachability from a predecessor configuration
statement: Let $E,B\in\mathbb N$, let $\mathcal O$ assign a Boolean answer to each of four indices and each Boolean word, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Let $\mathrm{st}$ be an 18-register machine state, $\ell$ a machine label, and $c$ an abstract configuration. If every register of $\mathrm{st}$ is at most $B$, and there is a finite run from the configuration obtained by taking one machine step from label $\ell$ with register values given by $\mathrm{st}$ to $c$, with every configuration strictly before its endpoint satisfying the guard with bound $B$, then there is also a finite run from the original configuration at label $\ell$ with those register values to $c$, with every configuration strictly before its endpoint satisfying the same guard.
hypotheses_covered: Oracle on four indices and Boolean words
Every register of $\mathrm{st}$ is at most $B$
One-step successor configuration reaches $c$ with the guard at every time strictly before the endpoint

Let $E,B\in\mathbb N$, let $\mathcal O$ be an oracle on four indices and Boolean words,
let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $\mathrm{st}$ be a machine state and $\ell$ a machine
label. If every register of $\mathrm{st}$ is at most $B$, and the configuration obtained
by taking one machine step from label $\ell$ with register values given by $\mathrm{st}$
is reachable from $c$ while satisfying the guard at every time before its endpoint, then
the original configuration at label $\ell$ with those register values is also reachable
